name: replica-machine
description: A site-replication team. REA reverse-engineers a reference site's page structure, scripts and network calls; an implementation engineer rebuilds it in code; an independent verifier diffs every detail before the lead signs off.

displayDescription.en: Use REA to reverse-engineer a reference site's pages, scripts and network calls, rebuild it in code, then have an independent verifier diff every detail before delivery.
displayDescription.zh: 用 REA 侦察参考站的页面、脚本与网络请求，据此复刻实现，独立验证员逐项比对后交付。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 复刻这个网站：先用 REA 研究它的页面结构、脚本和网络请求，再照着实现一个
defaultInitPrompt.en: Clone this site: use REA to study its page structure, scripts and network calls, then build one

quickPrompts.zh: 复刻这个网站：先用 REA 研究它的页面结构、脚本和网络请求，再照着实现一个
quickPrompts.en: Clone this site: use REA to study its page structure, scripts and network calls, then build one

quickPrompts.zh: 研究这个站的某个功能是怎么实现的：它发了哪些请求、脚本怎么写的
quickPrompts.en: Figure out how a feature on this site works: what requests it fires, how the scripts are written

quickPrompts.zh: 把复刻品和参考站逐项比对，看视觉、交互和网络还差在哪
quickPrompts.en: Diff my replica against the reference site: visuals, interactions, and network behavior
